title: Introduction to Rust
learning_outcomes: Explain and apply core ideas from Introduction to Rust.
Trace one small example and identify a meaningful edge case.
Use official documentation to check details that depend on the toolchain or ecosystem.

overview_visual.alt_text: Roadmap for module 1, Introduction to Rust.
overview_visual.caption: Representative milestones for module 1; all lessons remain listed in sequence.

notes: Understand Rust’s goals, trade-offs, ecosystem, and systems-programming use cases. Rust is a compiled language designed around explicit control and compile-time safety checks. Trade-offs depend on a project’s performance, interoperability, hiring, and delivery constraints.
